source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads and printed folios are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null. NP = Not Permitted and SPT = Supports Only are kept verbatim where printed.

title: Thermal Expansion for Nickel Alloys
notes: GENERAL NOTE: Coefficient A is the instantaneous coefficient of thermal expansion × 10−6 (mm/mm/°C). Coefficient B is the mean coef- ficient of thermal expansion × 10−6 (mm/mm/°C) in going from 20°C to indicated temperature. Coefficient C is the linear thermal expan- sion (mm/m) in going from 20°C to indicated temperature.
